_comment: Boot to AUX, as flashed on the car: aux-autoswitch + aux-boot-default + aux-boot-restore, plus spy-dump-userdata-partition and a piano ring tone. Confirmed on hardware 2026-09-28 (NAV): booted to AUX three times; see docs/VERIFICATION.md. builds/aux-boot.json is the same without the extras. Edit the paths before reusing.

_pairs.aux-boot-default: forces the restored Last_Source to 7; does not boot to AUX without aux-boot-restore
_pairs.aux-boot-restore: AUX's boot request (InitApp) and later requests (input handler) sent without PrOnly so they reach the restore, and the restored priority forced to AUX's 20
_pairs.spy-dump-userdata-partition: carried here, but it does not work: no USER_DATA tree reached the stick after SPYSTORE (observed 2026-09-28); the dump loses the calibration *.log and *regen* files

_settings: No USER_DATA payload, so the car's own settings - paired phones, destinations, presets - are NOT touched.
